New thought: Villains of the Multiverse purportedly includes ten Vengeance-style villain decks and two environment decks, but no hero decks. I'm perfectly happy with that arrangement; I've been thinking the Vengeful Five format would be even better with more options, and my simmering frustration for all the current environments is starting to fade so now I'll have new environment decks to glitch and moan over whenever I play Sentinels!

However, if memory serves, Vengeance was going to include only one environment deck until >G's legion of fans took the lawnmower to their stretch goals, allowing the Gods of the Multiverse to include a second environment in every copy of Vengeance.  Is there the possibility that the "stretch goals" during the pre-order event for Villains of the Multiverse could include hero decks as permanent additions to Villains?  I would say yes, it's possible, but we won't know until their standard-issue, ultra-teasing list of funding milestones is announced at the start of the campaign.

I'm also assuming that the number of preordered copies of Villains will be tracked separately, and its funding milestones attained separately, than those for the Sentinel Tactics products.
